name: create_purchase_order
title: Create purchase order
description: Create a purchase order (PO) with a supplier. Give request_no for an approved purchase request (it supplies item, quantity, cost centre and date), or item_code, quantity, cost_centre and need_by for a small direct order up to £50,000. confirm=false previews price, tax and value; confirm=true saves it. Returns a receipt with the order's real status: an APPROVED order still has to be released.

rate.description: omit to use the contract rate

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

status.description: DRAFT, WAITING FOR APPROVAL, APPROVED or RELEASED

warning.description: e.g. saved as DRAFT because the cost centre is closed
